button.name: action_create_ticket
button.invisible: ticket_id and not is_ticket_canceled or not confirmed_spec or confirmed_spec and state not in ['draft', 'cad_request_stage']
button.confirm: The action will create a Cad Request ticket. Are you sure you want to continue?

button.name: action_update_ticket_required
button.invisible: not ticket_id or ticket_id and is_ticket_canceled or not confirmed_spec or confirmed_spec and state not in ['cad_request_stage']
button.confirm: The action will move the ticket to the stage configured as CAD Update Required. Are you sure you want to continue?

button.name: action_finish_ticket
button.invisible: not ticket_id or ticket_id and is_ticket_canceled or not confirmed_spec or confirmed_spec and state not in ['cad_request_stage']
button.confirm: The action will move the ticket to the stage configured as CAD Finish. Are you sure you want to continue?
